content_html:
Southern Peru is a region full of history, impressive landscapes and unique experiences. If you plan to travel from Arequipa to Puno, this tour will take you through unforgettable scenes, from the majestic white city to the mystical Lake Titicaca. Here we tell you what to see and how to make the most of this trip.

Arequipa: The White City and its wonders

Your journey begins in Arequipa, known as the "White City" for its buildings made of ashlar, a light volcanic stone. You can't leave without visiting:

  • The Monastery of Saint Catherine: An impressive colonial complex that looks like a city within the city.
  • The Yanahuara Viewpoint: Offers a spectacular view of the Misti volcano.
  • The Colca Canyon: If you have time, take a trip to this impressive canyon, home of the majestic Andean condor.

Route from Arequipa to Puno: Options and landscapes

To get to Puno from Arequipa, you have several options:

  • By tourist bus (6-7 hours): It is the most popular and economical way. Some companies offer stops at points of interest.
  • By train (luxury option): The Belmond Andean Explorer train offers an exclusive experience with panoramic views and luxury service.
  • By private car: It allows you more flexibility to explore places along the way.

During the journey, you will pass through the National Reserve of Salinas and Aguada Blanca, where you can see vicuñas in their natural habitat, and the Andes Viewpoint, more than 4,900 meters above sea level.

Puno and Lake Titicaca: Culture and Living Tradition

Upon reaching fist, the "Capital of Peruvian Folklore", you will find a destination full of history and culture. Among the must-sees are:

  • The Floating Islands of the Uros: Communities that have built their islands with reeds on the lake.
  • Taquile Island: Famous for its weaving and community way of life.
  • Amantani Island: Ideal for an authentic experience with local families.
  • The Puno Cathedral and Pino Park: Key places to get to know the heart of the city.
